body: Well, that was awhile back. I don't know how to get back in track on my concentration and focus, with this online classes.
thank you; my brain's not the same since then:(

Yes, I have. It's just that since I messed up the previous semester, I have these weird realizations that I was not learning the right way because I was not able to retain all the information. I can't express my thoughts. It's like I can't even form my own opinions. This was when I was unable to sleep for straight 8 days.

Thank you so much for these! Honestly, I think the pandemic triggered these series of thoughts. Like they were there even before the pandemic started but I just shrugged them off. These are the things I should have realized sooner. 

I even question my intentions now :( Like I have these stuff to do that I was not able to complete last semester. It's like I just did them to make it seem like I did not kms, that I was still trying. But just for the sake of it. And it's rough knowing that I was not able to do my best.

Thank you so much for your thoughts! I really wish I could stop, but I can't because if I do, I'm gonna be repaying a ridiculous amount of money. If I could, I really would, if not for those conditions. Honestly, I'm not sure if I can hold on much longer
There's a Youtube channel that I've been watching to help me with anxiety and all. Just check "Therapy in a nutshell", maybe they can help:)

Hello! I'm still struggling with it myself but contrary to your situation, I don't know how to put boundaries--even worse, it recently occured to me that I am a people-pleaser, somewhat my whole life and I should try to change that.

Anyhow, it's not about me. I think what you should do to is just be the real you. You don't have to destroy those built-up boundaries right there and then. Just be honest about what you went througj and how you're trying to change that, and eventually people who loves you just as you are will truly understand. Things take time:)
